stories.title: Sources: Eagles reunite with TE Ertz as Goedert has MCL sprain
stories.summary: The Eagles are signing tight end Zach Ertz to their practice squad after the injury to starter Dallas Goedert and other injuries at the position.

stories.title: Sources: Colts' Pierce out several weeks; hoping to return this season
stories.summary: Colts WR Alec Pierce is expected to miss several weeks with a heel injury but will attempt to avoid surgery in the hopes of returning midseason.

stories.title: Darnold set to return to Seahawks practice Wednesday, Macdonald says
stories.summary: Coach Mike Macdonald also said "there is a chance" that quarterback Sam Darnold will play this week at Washington.

stories.title: Falcons QB Penix to make season debut Thursday vs. Packers
stories.summary: Quarterback Michael Penix Jr. will make his season debut this Thursday night when he starts against the Packers, the Falcons announced Monday.

stories.title: Bears coach says Williams week-to-week, but QB not ruled out for MNF
stories.summary: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams is considered "week-to-week" with a right hamstring injury he sustained in a 9-3 loss to the Vikings, coach Ben Johnson said Monday afternoon.
